N, B, C_red, m, |S_(m-2)| and P_pred are QUOTED FROM COMMITTED RECORDS or DETERMINED by exact arithmetic on them; the repaired-null mean, its sd and the as-recorded-null mean are SAMPLED by Monte Carlo.
